approval_required_for: A discovered ambiguity among multiple plausible exact sample-project wrapper, simulation-source, Vivado-export, or executable identities; approval must cite the competing evidence rather than guess.
Any requested change to architecture, pipeline semantics, memory layout, numeric policy/tolerance, or major reusable template.
Any proposed change to immutable checkpoint, stimulus, target-model oracle, semantic-testbench contract, or exact user-supplied wrapper/source hashes.

consumes: current case-adapter-resolved exact sample-project identity document
current exact wrapper, simulation-source, and source-hash manifest
current exact Vivado export facts and authorized tool profile
immutable checkpoint full Transformer-block tensor catalog and loader binding requirements
immutable stimulus provenance, target-model expected-output manifest, numeric-policy manifest, and semantic-testbench source hashes
hash-bound lower-layer promotion certificates as reusable invariants only
executable_actions.on_failure: Keep Stage7 fail-closed and retain the current verification-capability blocker. If discovery cannot establish one exact sample-project source set, Vivado export context, or authorized executable, emit a bounded ambiguity record for approval rather than guessing names or paths. If immutable semantic bindings cannot be proven, treat that as a harness/golden capability gap; do not generate expected outputs from random data, RTL output, or a substitute model, and do not reopen certified lower layers.
executable_actions.rationale: Repair the earliest violated contract: the board harness must bind the current exact sample-project identity, immutable source hashes, exact Vivado-export authority, authorized commands, and the semantic verification inputs before VCS can be interpreted. The multi-agent system has no supplied tool that implements exact-board harness binding or direct certified-kernel boundary probe generation, so planned_tool.exact_board_harness_binder and planned_tool.direct_certified_kernel_boundary_probe are required capability implementations. They may generate only harness/probe artifacts and must not alter DUT RTL, wrapper sources, checkpoint, oracle, input, numeric policy, or tolerance.

consumes: immutable checkpoint tensor catalog, stimulus, target-model expected outputs, and numeric policy
executable_actions.on_failure: If VCS does not execute, return to exact-board harness binding; do not interpret historical traces as current evidence. If VCS executes and reports a value, liveness, order, AXI, DDR, or protocol symptom, preserve the fresh trace and invoke repair.classify_fresh_board_causal_slice before any source patch. A functional mismatch or frontier stall is not a lower-layer failure unless the fresh trace meets the explicit contradiction requirements.
executable_actions.rationale: Once exact identity and authority pass, obtain the required current-layer trace before proposing any causal hardware repair. The replay must use the current exact board wrapper and generated semantic testbench, retain the immutable reference contract, and distinguish no direct-core ingress, accepted-but-not-launched, retained internal tokens, blocked output, and completed-but-unpropagated output. This is read-only instrumentation of the board testbench, not a lower-layer revalidation.

consumes: active contamination barriers and open retry requests from sacg_memory_truth
executable_actions.on_failure: If the trace is incomplete or ambiguous, keep the verification-capability/current-board blocker active and request a narrower replay; do not patch a guessed module. If no named lower-layer invariant is contradicted, emit only a board-wrapper/harness/runtime causal repair task. If and only if the trace directly contradicts a named certified invariant with required direct-core evidence, emit a scoped lower-layer backtrack request recording the challenged certificate, module/boundary, and trace; do not automatically rerun the lower layer or promote the board layer.
executable_actions.rationale: Turn fresh tool output into one bounded repair context and reconcile the active Stage7/Stage8 retry requests without treating rejected artifacts as validated inputs. The classifier must preserve the certified leaf and connected-kernel invariants unless the current trace directly contradicts one by showing named causal-boundary evidence together with direct core start, ingress, egress, and current certificate binding.

consumes: passing exact-project binding and case_axi_ddr_interface rerun reports
passing current targeted VCS replay, direct-boundary trace, numeric comparison, and DUT weight-consumption execution report
current board causal repair context showing no unresolved failure
immutable target-model reference, checkpoint catalog, stimulus, numeric policy, and generated semantic-testbench hashes
reusable current hashes for case_board_interface_discovery and case_multilayer_pipeline
executable_actions.on_failure: Record the first failing current board gate and its current trace in SACG, retain the associated retry/barrier, and return to repair.classify_fresh_board_causal_slice for a bounded current-layer repair decision. Do not promote to synthesis, implementation, bitstream, runtime ABI, or board runtime; do not alter golden outputs, tolerance, checkpoint, input stimulus, reference model, DUT scope, or exact sample-project sources.
executable_actions.rationale: Only after exact-board binding is valid and the targeted replay has passed its immutable semantic, weight-consumption, and boundary-trace conditions, rerun the remaining board-layer evidence in dependency order. This converts the current retry requests into a candidate Stage7 result; it does not permit backend promotion unless every required board gate and semantic-evidence check passes.

observations: The only direct current failed board gate is case_axi_ddr_interface. Its blockers are identity/authority failures: simulation.source_identity_sha256 is not bound to the current identity document; compile_authority and ordered-command authority_refs do not bind exact Vivado export facts; and the proposed executables are unauthorized. This is a verification-harness/provenance failure, not RTL behavior evidence.

functional_sim is dependency-blocked because the required board_tb.sv artifact is absent and case_axi_ddr_interface is not pass. The listed missing board semantic-evidence report is therefore downstream evidence absent by dependency, not an independent hardware defect.

The existing VCS diagnosis and boundary-trace paths are historical-only for the current decision because their evidence binding changed. The prior observation of completed wrapper ingress and zero accepted output beats is useful localization history, but it cannot establish a present kernel or board failure.

Hash-validated operator-leaf and connected single-transformer-layer certificates remain reusable. No current trace names a contradicted lower-layer invariant, and the scoped hierarchical context requires direct core start, ingress, egress, named causal-boundary, and current-certificate evidence before reopening the connected kernel.

The connected-kernel timing invariant is an elastic variable-latency token pipeline: boundary order and cross-token overlap are certified, while strict equal-cycle stage start/end is not required. Do not misclassify unequal stage latency as a kernel defect.

The authoritative SACG truth reports 15 active current-scope contamination barriers and six open retry requests (retry_request.0136, .0140, .0141, .0142, .0143, and .0144). Rejected Stage7/Stage8 artifacts are planning and debug inputs only; they cannot validate promotion. There are zero scoped open backtrack requests, so the omitted global cross-layer backtrack request is not actionable here.
The conditional specialist route was no_split. It provides no substitute for static binding checks, a current real-tool replay, or independent target-model semantic evidence.
proposed_actions: Implement a bounded exact-board harness binder that derives, rather than guesses, the current source identity, Vivado export contexts, authorized command executables, and generated board_tb.sv from the user-supplied sample project. It must add read-only direct certified-kernel probe declarations without modifying DUT RTL or sample-project wrapper sources.

After static identity/authority checks pass, run a fresh hash-bound VCS targeted replay using the immutable target-model oracle, same stimulus, fixed numeric policy, complete Transformer-block weight catalog, and executed weight-consumption instrumentation. Capture core lifecycle, direct ingress/egress valid-ready handshakes and acceptance counts, plus independent AXI/prefetch and board-output-frontier state.

Classify the earliest failing current-layer boundary from the fresh replay. Retain repair at board wrapper/harness/runtime integration unless the trace explicitly contradicts a named lower-layer certificate invariant with all required core boundary evidence; only then emit a scoped backtrack request, not an immediate lower-layer rerun.

If the targeted replay passes, rerun the remaining required board-layer gates in dependency order and assemble semantic evidence. If it fails, preserve the trace and causal context, update SACG retry/barrier state, and do not promote or preselect an RTL replacement.
risks: Changing the checkpoint, stimulus, target-model oracle, comparison policy, atol, rtol, max_mismatch_fraction, semantic-testbench contract, or exact sample-project wrapper/source hashes during this loop would invalidate comparison evidence. Tolerances must not be derived from DUT output or loosened during repair.

A board testbench that loads manifests without proving complete Transformer-block tensor hashes, bound loader mapping, and executed DUT consumption could falsely appear to use real weights. Model-tail tensors and behavior remain outside DUT scope and must not be added to the DUT golden boundary or coverage requirement.

Wrong board source identity, compile authority, command ordering, executable selection, AXI address-map interpretation, or memory/data ordering can mimic lifecycle/output-frontier failures. Independent AXI or prefetch progress does not prove output-frontier or lifecycle progress.

The output-frontier symptom alone cannot justify changing the certified kernel or leaf RTL. A direct boundary replay may instead localize no kernel ingress, no lifecycle launch after ingress, retained internal tokens, blocked output, or completed-but-unpropagated output.

The planned board-harness binding and direct-boundary-probe capability are not present as named grounded tools. Until implemented and accepted by existing checks, this remains a verification-capability repair rather than hardware correctness evidence.
